It goes the way the claim says: Prisma's @updatedAt injection (WriteArgs::update_datetimes) is skipped when the args map is empty, and the SQL connector short-circuits an empty update, so updateMany({where, data:{}}) emits no UPDATE and never bumps updatedAt — it is a silent no-op returning count 0, not an error. The claim's stated consequence is slightly off (the dropdown reads CalendarCache.updatedAt, not SelectedCalendar.updatedAt), but the mechanism it identifies is correct and the line does nothing.
